content:
alex (People Ops): Heads up 1: clearing up a few edge rules for out-of-cycle promos and comp changes after the last calibration. Posting this as a quick Q&A + examples. Please reply with any missing edge cases.

morgan (Eng Manager): Love it. Biggest pain: crosswalking IC leveling across specialized tracks (infra vs infra-sre vs platform). Managers keep getting different expectations.

alex (People Ops): Agreed. New guidance: use the Level Crosswalk doc as primary (short link: https://go.company/level-crosswalk). If a role maps between tracks, include the mapped target level + 1-line rationale. Calibration panel will accept one crosswalk exception per candidate if substantiated.

dana (IC): For title-only promotions because of band freeze, do we get a clear timeline for when comp follows? Had one person stuck on title for months.

alex (People Ops): We introduced a "band-hold" code for those cases. Manager must submit a short Path Plan: expected review date (within 90 days), owner (director/finance owner), and trigger criteria (budget, headcount slot, or comp committee approval). People Ops will tag the nomination with the band-hold code so case owners can track.

sasha (Recruiter): Quick question on external offers: if the candidate has an active external competing offer, what's the fastest route?

alex (People Ops): Fast-track: manager fills the retention form (link in promo form) and attaches a redacted offer summary + suggested counter range. For >15% base increase requests we need director + finance approval; for <=15% manager + director is enough. We aim to triage retention requests within 48 business hours.

comp-bot: :rotating_light: Reminder: Out-of-cycle promo form: https://go.company/out-of-cycle-promo (deadline: 7 days) :rotating_light:

morgan (Eng Manager): Evidence length? Committee flagged long writeups last time.

alex (People Ops): Please keep manager narrative to a single paragraph (30 sentences) plus up to two artifacts (PR/dashboards/ticket link). If you need to include peer quotes, 1-2 short excerpts only. Use this artifact format: `Artifact: <type> | <1-line context> | <link>`

dana (IC): If someone has been doing acting-manager work for 6 weeks, is that enough?

alex (People Ops): Acting responsibilities: default is 12 weeks sustained to qualify. Exceptions for mission-critical coverage (e.g., product-launch on hold without coverage) can be considered after 6 weeks with director sign-off and at least one peer validation. Mark the evidence as `acting-short` so committee can see the context.

sasha (Recruiter): Equity adjustments during promotions  are we still routing to recruiting?

alex (People Ops): Yes, equity sizing still runs through Recruiting+Comp. In the nomination, include current grant date/size and requested target range. Recruiting will propose the final grant and vesting schedule. For urgent retention offers that include equity acceleration, note `urgent-equity` in the form.

morgan (Eng Manager): How does payroll handle retro pay if promo approved outside payroll cutoff? Any tax smoothing?

payroll-bot: :money_with_wings: Payroll note: retro payments approved before the 12th of the month will be in that month's final run. Approvals after the 12th go into next month's run. For retro amounts >$5k, payroll may split payment across two runs for withholding smoothing. Contact payroll@company for special cases.

alex (People Ops): Another new item: calibration cadence changed to biweekly for the next two cycles to reduce backlog. That means faster decisions but also tighter evidence requirements. Please don't submit very long dossiers.

morgan (Eng Manager): If peer feedback conflicts a lot, what's the suggested reconciliation format?

alex (People Ops): One-paragraph reconciliation: 1) summarize disagreement, 2) point to objective artifacts, 3) state manager's final view. Keep it in the nomination under `Recon:`. Committee will prioritize manager narrative + artifacts.

dana (IC): Is there a formal appeals window?

alex (People Ops): Yes  10 business days from notification to submit new material. Appeals accepted only for new, material evidence or a process error. Use the appeal form link in your outcome email. Appeals will be reviewed by a separate panel.

sasha (Recruiter): Any change to backdating titles? We asked for 45 days backdate once.

alex (People Ops): Backdating policy unchanged: up to 30 days with director approval. >30 days needs HRBP + finance justification. Use `BackdateRequest` field in the nomination and include a business rationale.

comp-bot: :white_check_mark: Promo rules doc updated: https://go.company/promo-rules (updated 2026-04-02)

morgan (Eng Manager): Thanks  one last ask: can People Ops publish a short manager checklist (3 bullets) we can paste in PRs?

alex (People Ops): Yup  I'll drop a 3-bullet manager checklist and a short nomination template in the promo folder by EOD. If you have urgent cases tag `urgent-promo` in the form and DM me.

dana (IC): Appreciate the clarity.

alex (People Ops): Thanks all. If you see any edge cases (global hires, conversions, or contractor exceptions), flag them here and I'll add to the FAQ.
